We need to use filesystem commands: cd into documents; then maybe touch? But they want to draft a file - likely we should open editor but here just create file and add some placeholder text. Use echo to write content. So steps:

cd documents -> call cd({"folder":"documents"}).

Then create file TeamNotes.txt via touch or echo. We could do echo with content ""? They said draft a file to record all new ideas. Maybe include header comment. Let's create file with initial content: "# Team Notes\n\n- Idea 1:\n- Idea 2:" etc.

So after cd, run echo with content including newline escapes. In JSON, content field expects string. We'll provide multiline using \n. Also specify file_name: "TeamNotes.txt".

Thus output will be calls to cd and echo.
